ISOLATE: विश्लेषयति (c. of श्लिष्): v. To
insulate.
I. d from a society:
अपपात्रितः
(ता, तं).
ISOLATION: expr. by above, separately: q.v.

ISOSCELES:
i. triangle^1:
समद्विबाहुत्रिभुजः, K. d. and
sim. comp.s.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210319. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/53.
